issue.title: lsof warnings are hidden when checking worktrees
issue.body:
`land.sh` and `worktree_status.sh` ask `lsof` whether a worktree is in use, but they suppress lsof's warnings, so an lsof that cannot inspect some processes looks the same as one that found nothing.

## Done when

- lsof warnings stay visible in both scripts, and a land and a prune still succeed when lsof warns.
- `uv run --no-sync python3 tests/test_worktree_status.py` passes.
